fod-strip.text: Horizontal three-panel digital-first fantasy-office cartoon strip, clean and readable. Consistent clean near-white masthead/header row: first at the far left place the existing company gold-eye insignia used on its maroon banners as a distinctly malevolent EVIL EYE: angular narrowed gold eyelids and sharp outer tips, strongly slanted threatening brow, dark narrow vertical slit pupil and short surrounding gold rays, as a compact maroon-and-gold crest. Keep the company insignia's existing silhouette and design lineage. Do not use the old castle mark, a friendly generic eye, a nazar amulet, or a newly invented logo. To the right of the eye, place prominent left-aligned text exactly 'The Forces of Darkness, LLC.'; at the far right place smaller right-aligned text exactly 'by Star Splitter Visions'. The individual strip title remains underneath the main title on the left. Preserve these logo proportions, arrangement and identity across all strips; keep all header elements within the masthead, with clear spacing from the three story panels. CANONICAL MASTER GEOMETRY: 3600 x 1800 pixels overall (2:1 landscape). Reserve an uninterrupted clean near-white masthead across x=0..3599, y=0..299 (300 px, 1/6 of canvas). Below it, arrange precisely THREE separate 1200 x 1500 px panels, each 4:5 portrait: panel 1 crop [x=0,y=300,width=1200,height=1500], panel 2 [x=1200,y=300,width=1200,height=1500], panel 3 [x=2400,y=300,width=1200,height=1500]. Keep all required story art and lettering wholly inside its respective panel. No cross-panel balloons or overlapping panels, no outer gutters between panel crops; draw any borders INSIDE each crop. Preserve crop-safe margins around dialogue and faces, so each panel reads as a standalone mobile portrait image. Derived images consist of the three panel rectangles only, without masthead; add optional mobile branding separately, not over the crop. If generated below the target resolution, preserve the exact 2:1 and three 4:5 proportions during mastering before using these pixel crop coordinates. Maintain the show-level digital-first color finish: cool whites and gray-violet neutrals, cool shadows, localized amber light only. Do not reintroduce global beige or sepia tint. Bold inked outlines, clean repeatable silhouettes, deliberate crisp cel shadows, readable deadpan acting, spacious unobstructed speech balloons. Preserve body-size hierarchy (Hork far larger than Eric), established outfits, and exact supplied dialogue and speaker ownership. The evil occupation, dungeon, curses, raids or army infrastructure remains visibly real. Keep a balanced comic rhythm; let the final panel deliver the authored reversal. Each strip stands alone, without invented story continuity. PROP AND COSTUME CONTINUITY: Treat all three panels as views of one continuous physical scene, not separate set designs. Use only story-relevant foreground objects; generally no more than three small loose tabletop props unless the authored action requires more. Avoid decorative piles of bottles, books, scrolls and gadgets. Keep each recurring object's quantity, color, silhouette and position stable across panels unless the scripted action explicitly moves it. Preserve exact costume layers, eyewear, horns, markings, accessories, facial construction and character proportions across panels. Camera changes do not authorize new furniture or redesigned props. Favor a few distinctive location cues and clean negative space over visual clutter.
